reviews.comment: Dr. Herring was a good prof. A lot of the topics presented were put in concrete contexts, but in a real application, they are not. He's passionate about the topics but could drag on a bit. The lab portion was pointless- did not learn much and were expected to know the material on the practicum when we weren't really taught the material.

Dr. Herring is so knowledgable about cattle management and has so much experience! Really good about answering questions and meeting outside class. Lots of lab participation assignments/homework and a big ranch group project at the end. Quality of lab depends on the TA. Exams aren't bad just study the notes and anything covered in lab.

Dr. Herring was one of the best professors I ever had. I took him for both ANSC 406 and last semester in ANSC 605 and both were some of the best & most entertaining classes I ever had. I highly recommend you take his courses. He is also very patient and understanding of student conflicts. His lectures are entertaining and labs are fun and engaging

Dr. Herring is awesome! I really appreciated how patient he was when a topic wouldnt make sense to me and he had to explain it a couple times. He never got frustrated or made me feel dumb. Hes a really nice guy and he cracks the occasional joke sometime, so lectures arent too bad. Highly recommend!
He takes attendance every now and then. Tests are what he goes over in LECTURE, so attendance is helpful. Projects and paper is very thorough. Try to turn in early and get out of the way.
